Hero_Desc_RimChaos:
Due to the absence of the original chaos, Shaydi, Rim chose to replace her, becoming a new chaos.
She tries her best to cause confusion, but still she seems clumsy somehow.
Now she's even willing to abandon her lame jokes to be the perfect chaos... but is that really possible?
Album_Like_RimChaos: Apostles fleeing in fear after seeing her terrifying figure
Album_RimChaos1: When Shaydi stepped down from ruling the Phantom Marsh, Rim became its new order. Most thought Rim's lame jokes would turn the Phantom Marsh into a Frozen Marsh... But, simply mimicking Shaydi, she ascended as the new chaos phantom.
Album_RimChaos2: It's uncertain whether the other phantoms truly follow the brand-new Rim... But one thing is clear, she has destructive power, though a bit different from Shaydi. She does Shaydi's usual dimensional portal pranks, of course, even summons all sorts of bizarre entities from other dimensions.
Album_RimChaos3: Many Apostles are bewildered by Rim's sudden change in personality, but of course, the most bewildered are the phantoms. Particularly, those who used to disregard Rim are now at loss, realizing she had turned into a rather decent Phantom.
Album_RimChaos4: Shaydi acts indifferent about Rim's change but secretly seems anxious. Especially whenever Rim does bizarre things, claiming to mimic Shaydi, Shaydi quickly retorts that it's not similar at all.
Album_RimChaos5: When I asked Rim why she was doing this, she axed the question. Then she explained, Shaydi's position must always be maintained... Honestly, this isn't so bad. Rather, Shaydi changing jobs is the issue.
Album_RimChaos6: Though Rim plays quite a lot of pranks, she seems to feel uneasy about her personality change. When teasing Apostles she was once close to, she anxiously tried to read their faces, fearing they might make a break with her.
Album_RimChaos7: When no one is watching, Rim approaches Shaydi, quietly whining to switch back to their original roles. Shaydi, probably finding her funny, seems to be enjoying the situation.

LoveLetter_RimChaos:
Hello, Master.

Should you really be so kind to a ghost who represents chaos? I tried to defeat you before, after all. You would have every reason to resent me, yet you treat me as though it barely matters. I always wanted to attack whenever I saw you, but now that desire leaves me strangely unsettled. Even so, next time I truly will not hesitate.

...Everything above was a joke. My tricks have improved quite a bit, have they not? You were frightened while reading it, right? Be honest and tell me that you were scared the next time we meet. Unless, of course, you would rather be frightened then.
LoveCall_RimChaos:
Ehehe... Hello, Master. It is Rim.
Hmm? You recognized my condition the instant I said hello. Impressive.
That is right. At present, I am buried in chaos.

Yes... 'buried' is likely the correct expression.
Lately, I often doubt whether this heart that yearns for chaos is truly my own.
I say that I seek chaos to preserve its balance with order... yet the most chaotic thing of all was my own mind.
Which form is truly me, and which feelings are truly mine?
...Perhaps that is why I want to play even more tricks on you, Master.
Whenever I am with you, this confused heart changes into a quiet warmth.

Master, whenever I change into this form in the future... will you stay with me?
When I am with you, I can feel that my heart is still here...
Thank you for listening.
Now, I am off to play another trick.
